text:
An example of a redox reaction is shown.
Zn  +  Cu2+→  Zn2+  +  Cu
Which statement about the reaction is correct?
Zn is the oxidising agent and it oxidises Cu2+.
A
Zn is the oxidising agent and it reduces Cu2+.
B
Zn is the reducing agent and it oxidises Cu2+.
C
Zn is the reducing agent and it reduces Cu2+.
D

options.label: A
options.text: Zn is the oxidising agent and it oxidises Cu2+.

options.label: B
options.text: Zn is the oxidising agent and it reduces Cu2+.

options.label: C
options.text: Zn is the reducing agent and it oxidises Cu2+.

options.label: D
options.text: Zn is the reducing agent and it reduces Cu2+.
